experiment23_additional_implementation_f.problem: Logits/valid are concatenated by private g, but CE uses original train-order self.y instead of self.y[cat(query_indices)]. The raw P1 comparison repeats the same ordering mistake.
experiment23_additional_implementation_f.implication: The reported 0.99918 R3/raw-P1 gradient cosine compares two objectives sharing an incorrect label order; it does not establish near-collinearity with the correctly ordered historical P1 objective. This confounds mechanism attribution; it does not uniquely explain every classification change.

experiment22_analysis_direction_failure.historical_selftest_limitation: The two toy groups were identical, so a sign reversal remained invisible.

failures_review.20_M3: Non-image student training accuracy ~0.5018, entropy ~0.6926, ph CE ~0.694; KL rises ~0.0012 to ~0.2601. A nonzero KL gradient did not establish learned disease semantics; AUC below D4 and shuffled M4.
failures_review.21_N3: Age-sex weighted group teacher ~0.4885 ASD probability, cross-patient SD ~0.0169, accuracy ~0.5088. Averaging diluted individual disease information; student stays near chance.
failures_review.22_P1_P3: Paired matching improves age-sex balance, but embedding-derived coupling does not stabilize improvements; P3-P4 AUC change is fold-sensitive. Patient change direction is reversed in the historical analyzer.
failures_review.23_R3: Reported age residualization and near-parallel CE gradients are additionally confounded by the verified auxiliary label-order error above. Site fallback is frequent; small AUC differences coexist with worse ACC/SPE.
failures_review.DRPA: Direct/shared feature alignment and gates did not show consistent independent diagnostic gains; learned projections need not identify useful shared factors.
failures_review.PCCI: Fusion residuals reduce classification performance; correct correspondence evidence is weak and high perturbation need not help diagnosis.
failures_review.CMCV: Raw age/sex did not establish stable independent probability-AUC/CE increment; this is not proof of universal absence of useful nonlinear information.
failures_review.LCRA: Local relation loss is learnable but effective graph/forward probability perturbations are very small; optimization of an auxiliary quantity does not prove an effective prediction mechanism.
